_note: Hint-AUC values of the two shipped examples, recorded by the authors and checked in CI (examples/check_expected.py). The 'torch' backend is torchvision (resize) + torchmetrics 1.4.0 (SSIM), the paper's evaluator; 'pillow' is the fallback without PyTorch (Pillow float32 bilinear resize + scikit-image SSIM). MSE and PSNR agree between the backends to about 1e-7; only SSIM differs (a few 1e-5). Regions of equal area are ordered with tie_break='stable' (the default of evaluate_colorizer), so the numbers do not depend on the CPU.

demo.command: hintauc demo --out <dir>   (synthetic illustration, path_method=geodesic, metrics mse psnr ssim)
